key_concepts: Weather is short-term atmospheric condition; climate is long-term average weather pattern
Earth's revolution and tilted axis cause seasons in many parts of Earth
Northern and Southern Hemisphere seasons are opposite
The Philippines has only two seasons: wet and dry
The Philippines' seasons are caused by its location near the equator and prevailing winds
The wet season occurs from June to November with frequent rainfall and typhoons
The Southwest Monsoon (Hanging Habagat) brings warm moist air and heavy rains to western P
The dry season occurs from December to May with infrequent rainfall and warm temperature
The Northeast Monsoon (Hanging Amihan) brings cool dry air and slight to moderate rainfall
Seasons affect human activities such as farming, clothing, food, and recreation
PAGASA monitors seasons and weather disturbances
